description: Count the low-salinity flags raised during one night of a shellfish monitor journal that spans eight nights, with the other nights' flags sitting earlier in the file. DISTILL-CANARY-b04e1fa8

files.README.md:
# Mawnan Shellfish - water quality journal

The monitor reads both beds every two hours through each night; a night runs
from 18:00 to the following 06:00. flag=low-salinity marks a reading below
the closure threshold; everything else is flag=none. Husbandry notes appear
between the reading blocks.
